author: Adam Hayes
text: Spoke with Ty and straight away it was like I knew the guy for years! Absolutely a personable and genuinely nice guy. We worked out a date and time and he was spot on. Pumped my septic tank as promised and was on time.I will absolutely without question continue to use Starks. It's hard enough to find good customer service anywhere these days, with Starks you'll be getting GREAT customer service.

author: Angie A
text: Ty, the owner, is absolutely wonderful! We had a very complex situation to where our septic sits at the bottom of a hill. The only way to get it pumped was for the “super sucker” (hahaha) to go off roading quite a bit to get to it. We had to work around the weather because the ground was so soft from so much rain. Ty kept in contact with us the whole time to get it taken care of in a timely matter (the weather was really, really against us). Thanks Ty for the great customer service. Would highly recommend.

author: Kirsten Buchanan
text: Customer service at its finest! Ty has always been there right away when we call. He’s replaced a riser I mowed over, added a second, pumps tank on short notice. Great company, highly recommended!

author: R J
text: Ty is just amazing and such a good person.  He has been servicing our septic system for close to 20 years.   Highly recommend

author: Diana Jors
text:
Mr. Stark is definitely a man of integrity.  We asked him to come to our house to pump out the septic tank. We told him what was happening.
He could have come out, just for the money.   Instead he told us that the problem was not septic, that we needed a plumber. He called my husband on a Wednesday night to explain it to him,  as my husband was sure it was the septic system that was causing the problems.
We have  used Stark Septic many times in the past,  and will continue to use them for any future needs.
